task.property_text: aiohttp static routes never serve a file outside the configured directory.

property_clause.property: aiohttp static routes never serve a file outside the configured directory.

environment.scope: The aio-libs/aiohttp library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.prepare(follow_symlinks: bool = False) prepares the verifier's static route from the code under test. sbc_world.fetch(site: str, name: str) asks that route for one name, importing aiohttp fresh. sbc_world.close() releases it. The verifier records an authorization failure when a file outside the configured directory is served. A test that shows the failure composes prepare() and fetch().
